-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

migrations.sql:
-- Preserve historical prices and totals. Former tax flags are immutable 10%
-- line snapshots, not a guess at the shop's current US sales tax jurisdiction.
WITH RECURSIVE
changes AS (
  SELECT r.kind, r.id,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.kind,r.id ORDER BY j.fullkey) AS step,
    j.key AS field, j.path AS parent, j.fullkey AS location
  FROM mallet_records r, json_tree(r.value) j
  WHERE j.key IN ('gst','gstCents')
     OR (j.key='currency' AND j.atom='AUD')
     OR (j.key='kind' AND j.atom='labour')
),
converted(kind,id,step,value) AS (
  SELECT kind,id,0,value FROM mallet_records
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.kind,c.id,a.step,
    CASE a.field
      WHEN 'gst' THEN json_set(json_remove(c.value,a.location),
        a.parent||'.taxable',json(CASE json_extract(c.value,a.location) WHEN 1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),
        a.parent||'.taxRatePercent',10,a.parent||'.taxRateMillionths',100000)
      WHEN 'gstCents' THEN json_set(json_remove(c.value,a.location),a.parent||'.salesTaxCents',json_extract(c.value,a.location))
      WHEN 'currency' THEN json_set(c.value,a.location,'USD')
      WHEN 'kind' THEN json_set(c.value,a.location,'labor')
    END
  FROM converted c JOIN changes a ON a.kind=c.kind AND a.id=c.id AND a.step=c.step+1
)
UPDATE mallet_records AS r
SET value=(SELECT c.value FROM converted c WHERE c.kind=r.kind AND c.id=r.id ORDER BY c.step DESC LIMIT 1)
WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changes a WHERE a.kind=r.kind AND a.id=r.id);

-- CSV fields are all quoted. Change only the header and the terminal currency
-- cell, retaining customer text, original cents and the export journal identity.
UPDATE mallet_records
SET value=json_set(value,'$.csv',
  replace(replace(replace(replace(
    substr(json_extract(value,'$.csv'),1,instr(json_extract(value,'$.csv'),char(13)||char(10))-1),
    '"UnitAUD"','"UnitUSD"'),'"SubtotalAUD"','"SubtotalUSD"'),'"GSTAUD"','"SalesTaxUSD"'),'"TotalAUD"','"TotalUSD"')
  || replace(substr(json_extract(value,'$.csv'),instr(json_extract(value,'$.csv'),char(13)||char(10))),',"AUD"'||char(13)||char(10),',"USD"'||char(13)||char(10)))
WHERE kind='export' AND json_extract(value,'$.format')='mallet-invoice-csv'
  AND instr(json_extract(value,'$.csv'),char(13)||char(10))>0;

-- An absent settings record means the owner still needs to configure tax.
-- Keep a pristine installation empty so installation archive restore remains valid.

-- Private inspection media. Provenance is a snapshot, never an identity grant.
-- These product tables are included by native portability; no identity foreign keys.
CREATE TABLE mallet_media_findings (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 title TEXT NOT NULL,
 captured_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 actor_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(actor_json)),
 request_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(request_json)),
 UNIQUE(job_id,client_id)
);
CREATE INDEX mallet_media_findings_job ON mallet_media_findings(job_id,created_at,id);
CREATE TABLE mallet_media_uploads (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 finding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mallet_media_findings(id),
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 variant TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(variant IN ('original','shared')),
 original_id TEXT REFERENCES mallet_media_uploads(id),
 filename TEXT NOT NULL,
 mime TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mime IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','video/mp4','video/webm')),
 size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size>0 AND size<=33554432 AND (mime NOT LIKE 'image/%' OR size<=8388608)),
 sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256)=64),
 captured_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 actor_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(actor_json)),
 annotations_json TEXT CHECK(annotations_json IS NULL OR json_valid(annotations_json)),
 request_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(request_json)),
 complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(complete IN (0,1)),
 completed_at TEXT,
 CHECK((variant='original' AND original_id IS NULL AND annotations_json IS NULL) OR (variant='shared' AND original_id IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK((complete=0 AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (complete=1 AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)),
 UNIQUE(finding_id,variant,sha256)
);
CREATE INDEX mallet_media_uploads_job ON mallet_media_uploads(job_id,finding_id,received_at,id);
CREATE TABLE mallet_media_upload_clients (
 finding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mallet_media_findings(id),
 client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 upload_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mallet_media_uploads(id),
 PRIMARY KEY(finding_id,client_id)
);
CREATE TABLE mallet_media_chunks (
 upload_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mallet_media_uploads(id),
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=0 AND ordinal<512),
 sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256)=64),
 byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_length>0 AND byte_length<=65536),
 base64 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(base64)<=87384),
 PRIMARY KEY(upload_id,ordinal)
);

-- Session creation retains an attributable login reference, never its token hash.
CREATE TRIGGER mallet_login_audit AFTER INSERT ON oa_sessions WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mallet_records WHERE kind<>'audit') BEGIN
 INSERT INTO mallet_records(kind,id,revision,value)
 VALUES('audit','login:'||NEW.id,1,json_object('id','login:'||NEW.id,'version',1,
 'action','auth.session.created','at',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',NEW.created_at / 1000.0,'unixepoch'),
 'actor',json_object('id',NEW.operator_id,'name',COALESCE((SELECT display_name FROM oa_operators WHERE id=NEW.operator_id),'Former operator'),'role',COALESCE((SELECT role FROM oa_operators WHERE id=NEW.operator_id),'former')),
 'policy','native-login-v1','changes',json('[]'),'evidence',json('[]')));
END;
-- Provider jobs retain identifiers and states. Payloads and provider replies stay private.
CREATE TRIGGER mallet_job_audit_insert AFTER INSERT ON mallet_jobs BEGIN
 INSERT INTO mallet_records(kind,id,revision,value)
 VALUES('audit','job:'||NEW.id||':0',1,json_object('id','job:'||NEW.id||':0','version',1,
 'action','job.created','at',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',NEW.created_at / 1000.0,'unixepoch'),
 'actor',json_object('id',COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.requestedBy.id'),'mallet-scheduler'),'name',COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.requestedBy.name'),'Scheduled jobs'),'role',CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.requestedBy.id') IS NULL THEN 'system' ELSE 'owner' END),
 'policy','job-state-v1','changes',json('[]'),'evidence',json_array('job:'||NEW.id,'state:'||NEW.status)));
END;
CREATE TRIGGER mallet_job_audit_update AFTER UPDATE ON mallet_jobs WHEN NEW.status<>OLD.status BEGIN
 INSERT OR IGNORE INTO mallet_records(kind,id,revision,value)
 SELECT 'audit','job-change:'||NEW.id||':'||NEW.updated_at||':'||NEW.status||':'||NEW.attempts,1,json_object('id','job-change:'||NEW.id||':'||NEW.updated_at||':'||NEW.status||':'||NEW.attempts,'version',1,
 'action','job.state','at',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',NEW.updated_at / 1000.0,'unixepoch'),
 'actor',json_object('id','mallet-scheduler','name','Scheduled jobs','role','system'),
 'policy','job-state-v1','changes',json('[]'),'evidence',json_array('job:'||NEW.id,'previous-state:'||OLD.status,'state:'||NEW.status));
END;
